hypothesis: Reduce costly entry timing while accounting for missed winners and changes in market conditions.

research.mechanism: Chronological tree models estimate net carry, post-window adverse excursion and one-session deferral value. Regime validation and recent counterfactual checks include the cost of missed winners. Uncertain, unfamiliar or unsupported conditions restore baseline entry size.
research.falsification: Reject performance claims if exposure-matched net returns and their uncertainty guard fail, drawdown deteriorates materially, execution costs or delay erase the benefit, or ablations show that mechanisms add no value.
